info.name: SDG Recycling Backend API
info.description:
Shared API test collection for local, shared Azure, and personal sandbox environments.

Import one collection, then switch Postman environments. Run Auth -> Login Admin and Auth -> Login Student first to populate tokens automatically.

Safe Smoke and Admin Read folders are intended for routine checks. Mutation folders create/archive test data and should be used deliberately.

exec: pm.test('badge progress shape', function () { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.earned).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(data.locked).to.be.an('array'); });

item.name: 04 - Student Action Tests
item.description: These requests can create student activity. They are safe for sandbox smoke testing but may change progress/submission state.

exec: pm.test('submission accepted or already blocked by prior run', function () { pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

if (pm.response.code === 201) { const submissionId = pm.response.json().data.submission.id; pm.environment.set('createdSubmissionId', submissionId); pm.collectionVariables.set('createdSubmissionId', submissionId); }

item.name: 05 - Admin Mutation Tests
item.description: Run in order after logging in. These requests intentionally create and archive test records.

exec: const value = json && json.data && json.data.content && json.data.content.id;

item.name: 06 - Upload Tests
item.description: Set testFilePath in the active Postman environment before running file upload requests.

exec: pm.test('upload succeeds when testFilePath is set', function () { pm.expect([201, 400, 500]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const uploadId = pm.response.json().data.upload.id; pm.environment.set('uploadId', uploadId); pm.collectionVariables.set('uploadId', uploadId); }
pm.test('content image upload succeeds when testFilePath is set', function () { pm.expect([201, 400, 500]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
